root_cause: Linux flock locks inode, not pathname. If .nox-deepseek-owner.lock is unlinked/recreated during Range read or short disk writes, second owner may lock a different inode while first continues writing.
fix: The original download_one validates lock inode/owner/mode/link count immediately after flock and before every chunk. Reconciled a concurrent separate short-write patch: _write_checked now revalidates same owner lock before every short-write continuation. Unsafe lock permissions and identity replacement fail closed.
